name: Auto Pilot 4 Agents
author: oliwier-xiao
description: Prompt scheduler for AI coding agents: write prompts now and Auto Pilot sends each one later to a Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent or Pi session, in a few minutes, at a clock time, or right after a usage or rate limit resets. Scheduled jobs wait in a queue in the bar and run headless and unattended, even overnight, as cron-like systemd user timers, so your automation fires while the screen is locked.

barWidget.description: Scheduled prompts for your coding agents, with a countdown to the next one.

schema.label: Next to the bar icon
schema.description: Next run shows the countdown to the soonest armed job. Queued count shows how many jobs are armed. Nothing leaves the icon alone.
